node.title: Structural Awareness — Operational Residual and Online Context Plasticity
node.summary: Contenido de la fuente: 1. Three meanings of residual · 2. SA-O1 — conditional witnessed residual · 3. SA-O2 — retained difference versus irreversible discard.

relations: Operational tracking could retain permitted unresolved traces before lossy admission, so that later qualification can revisit evidence that actually exists.
No se propone retención indiscriminada; fuente, propósito, privacidad y plazo siguen limitando lo que puede guardarse.
The dual-time contract makes a later implementation obligation explicit: historical reinterpretation and current permission to rely on a certificate must be evaluated separately.
El contrato permanece en PR60 y requiere infraestructura independiente de firmas, reloj, derechos y estado de revocación.
